meta.note: Every fact published on the site should trace to a row in one of these groups. 'Official' means Kalshi's own documentation, Kalshi's own API response, Kalshi's own fee schedule PDF, or a primary data publisher Kalshi itself names. 'Project' means a rule written for this dashboard, which is not Kalshi data and never claims to be.
meta.verificationMethod: Each official row was opened and read in this session. API rows were exercised with a live GET against the demo host; the exact request is in the row.

officialDocs.title: API Environments and Endpoints
officialDocs.states: Production REST is external-api.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2; demo REST is external-api.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/v2 with demo-api.kalshi.co as an also-supported host. Demo WebSocket is wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2. Credentials are not shared between environments.

officialDocs.title: Test In The Demo Environment
officialDocs.states: Demo offers mock funds; the docs warn that demo prices and behaviour may not reflect real markets.

officialDocs.title: Get Markets
officialDocs.states: GET /markets filters by status open|closed|settled|unopened, supports series_ticker and event_ticker, pages by cursor, and caches responses for a short time.

officialDocs.title: Get Events
officialDocs.states: GET /events excludes multivariate events; with_nested_markets returns each event's markets; the status filter matches on child market statuses.

officialDocs.title: Get Market Orderbook
officialDocs.states: GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook returns yes bids and no bids only, as price/quantity pairs, in orderbook_fp.

officialDocs.title: Orderbook Responses
officialDocs.states: There are no asks: a YES bid at X is a NO ask at (100 - X) and vice versa. This is why the dashboard's ask ladder is labelled derived.

officialDocs.title: Get Series List
officialDocs.states: GET /series filters by category and tags; series objects carry category, categories, tags, fee_type and fee_multiplier.

officialDocs.title: Get Market Candlesticks
officialDocs.states: GET /series/{series_ticker}/markets/{ticker}/candlesticks takes start_ts and end_ts in seconds and period_interval 1, 60 or 1440 minutes; at most 5,000 periods per request; recent candles lag a few seconds.

officialDocs.title: Market Lifecycle
officialDocs.states: Market statuses are initialized, active, inactive, closed, determined, disputed, amended, finalized. result is yes, no or scalar. Only finalized is terminal, and determined results can still be disputed.

officialDocs.title: API Keys and request signing
officialDocs.states: Sign timestamp_ms + METHOD + path, with the query string stripped. Ed25519 keys sign directly; RSA uses RSA-PSS-SHA256. Timestamp must be within 30 seconds. Headers are KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY, -SIGNATURE and -TIMESTAMP.

officialDocs.title: Rate Limits and Tiers
officialDocs.states: Every authenticated request costs tokens from a refilling bucket; unauthorised public requests have separate limits; a rate-limited call returns 429 and should be retried with exponential backoff.

officialDocs.title: Kalshi fee schedule (PDF)
officialDocs.states: Taker fee = round up(M x 0.07 x C x P x (1 - P)); maker fee uses 0.0175. No settlement fee and no membership fee. Lists non-standard series multipliers.

officialDocs.title: Fee Rounding
officialDocs.states: Direct member balances are aligned to $0.0001; a trade fee is computed then rounded, and a rounding fee restores the balance precision.

officialDocs.title: Create Order (V2)
officialDocs.states: Orders are placed at POST /portfolio/events/orders with ticker, side bid|ask, count, price, time_in_force and self_trade_prevention_type. The legacy /portfolio/orders write endpoints now return 410.

officialDocs.title: Get Balance
officialDocs.states: GET /portfolio/balance returns balance and portfolio value; it is metered in its own bucket at 1 per second on Basic and Advanced.

officialDocs.title: Get Positions
officialDocs.states: GET /portfolio/positions returns unsettled positions by default; count_filter=position gives non-zero holdings; settlement_status accepts unsettled, settled or all.

officialDocs.title: Get Fills
officialDocs.states: GET /portfolio/fills returns the member's fills; fills before the historical cutoff are only in /historical/fills.

officialDocs.title: Get Settlements
officialDocs.states: GET /portfolio/settlements returns settlement records in the live data set.

officialDocs.title: Get Exchange Status
officialDocs.states: GET /exchange/status reports exchange_active, trading_active and per-shard status entries.

officialDocs.title: Quick Start: WebSockets
officialDocs.states: WebSocket connections are authenticated at the handshake; public channels are ticker, trade, market_lifecycle_v2 and multivariate_market_lifecycle; Kalshi pings after 10 seconds of silence.

officialDocs.title: Quick Start: Market Data (public reads)
officialDocs.states: Market data endpoints need no API key; examples use the external-api host and the orderbook_fp arrays.

officialDocs.title: Fixed-point representation
officialDocs.states: Prices are fixed-point dollar strings and counts are fixed-point strings with an fp suffix; responses carry 2-6 decimal places.

officialDocs.title: Understanding Pagination
officialDocs.states: List endpoints page with an opaque cursor; pass it back unchanged and stop when it is empty.

officialDocs.title: Kalshi Help — Fees
officialDocs.states: A transaction fee is charged on expected earnings; some markets carry maker fees; the full schedule is the PDF.

projectRules.title: Swing threshold
projectRules.rule: A swing alert is recorded when the observed YES mid-price differs from the previous observation of the same market by at least $0.10 in either direction. Written for this dashboard from the user's specification.

projectRules.title: Research score (0-100)
projectRules.rule: Weighted heuristic: move size 40, crossable depth 25, spread tightness 15, 24h volume 10, freshness 10. Not a forecast, not ROI, not Kalshi data.

projectRules.title: Topic routing
projectRules.rule: crypto, elections and culture route on the series category; golf routes on the Golf tag because Golf is not a category; gas routes on the Gas tag, which in the demo covers diesel only.

projectRules.title: Strategies
projectRules.rule: Five entry rules (momentum, fade, dip buyer, longshot collector, favorite carry), one simulated position per market at a time, one contract per entry, settled only on a finalized binary result.

projectRules.title: Starting balance
projectRules.rule: $1,000 of simulated cash, chosen for this project. It is not the demo account's balance; the demo balance is shown separately and only when the authenticated snapshot succeeds.

projectRules.title: Polling bounds
projectRules.rule: At most 12 series and 60 markets per topic per cycle, at most 40 tracked resolutions, 720 chart points per market, 14-day retention, 400 feed rows.

projectRules.title: Simulated fills use taker fees
projectRules.rule: Every simulated entry pays the published taker fee; no maker rebate is modelled.
